readiness.summary: This app needs changes before Deployz can deploy it.

findings.title: Your database needs a supported engine
findings.whyItMatters: Deployz provisions, connects, and backs up the database for every customer deployment, and it can only do that for PostgreSQL or MySQL.
findings.suggestedOutcome: Move the data layer to PostgreSQL or MySQL, or set the app to use one of them if it supports both.
findings.technicalEvidence: Unsupported database: SQLite driver better-sqlite3. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only; an embedded file database does not survive in the container model.
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: This app uses SQLite, a database stored in a file on the app server. Deployz cannot host it because app disks are wiped on every deploy.

findings.title: Runs as several services
findings.whyItMatters: Deployz provisions one container per application with managed database, cache, and storage. Extra infrastructure the app expects would not exist at runtime.
findings.suggestedOutcome: Build an image that runs only the web process, and declare each other process as a worker.
findings.technicalEvidence: Unsupported container setup: docker/Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 3 long-running services (init-db-migration, svc-web, svc-workers) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
findings.plainEnglishExplanation: This app's image starts several long-running processes (web, API, worker) under a supervisor, but Deployz runs one process per container.
